briefing:
One nervous exec, one stolen route, many holes in the hull. Your job is to make the derelict look like a scenic shortcut until the airlock opens.

VIP on comms: "If I die, my lawyer lives forever."

beats.insert: ESCORT LOG // VIP tethered to your lead with shame and high-vis tape. Their perfume fights the ammonia. Charming.
beats.complication: HOSTILE // Drones ping the VIP suit like they recognize the logo. Coincidence is a word lawyers eat for breakfast.
beats.crisis: BREACH // Pressure drop in the flank corridor. VIP screams into a frequency only dogs deserve. Keep them breathing, keep moving.

debrief.win: VIP intact, ego bruised. Convoy bonus lands. Cookie refuses to let the exec wash a mug. Policy.
debrief.partial: VIP lived but the story will exaggerate. Payout cut, morale intact. They tip anyway because guilt is a currency.
debrief.fail: VIP lost or you legged it without them. Client fury arrives before the airlock finishes cycling. Crew speaks in whispers for a day.
